notes.text: Omar enjoyed the painting activity today.
Laila played with the blocks for a long time.

announcements.title: Trip on Friday
announcements.text: We are going to the park this Friday. Please send a water bottle and a hat.

announcements.title: Butterflies class: bring a spare outfit
announcements.text: Please pack one set of spare clothes in your child's bag.

announcements.title: Parents meeting
announcements.text: Parents meeting next Sunday at 5 PM.

Build strength and coordination through active outdoor games and freely chosen playground activities.

Rest in a calm, comfortable space while teachers support each child’s individual sleep routine.
Take a break to enjoy a healthy snack, drink water, and recharge for the afternoon.

Gather belongings, share a brief day update with a teacher, and get ready to go home.
